history.name: Prose on the input, short values as options
history.description: Every command that writes takes its content as a structured payload on standard input or from a file, with individual values also settable as command-line options that win over the payload. Long prose — a description, three multi-sentence bullets — goes in as text rather than being wrestled through shell quoting, while a one-word correction like a size stays a single option.
history.dev_notes: payload() in src/commands/write.mjs; unknown fields are refused with the allowed list, which catches a typo'd key rather than silently dropping it.
